name: run
description: Detect the framework and run the test suite.
body: Run the tests for $ARGUMENTS using the `testing-strategy` skill. Detect the real runner (jest/vitest/pytest/go test/cargo test/etc.) and run it. Report pass/fail with real output; if failing, summarize and offer to debug. Never claim success without running.

name: coverage
description: Measure test coverage and highlight meaningful gaps.
body: Measure coverage for $ARGUMENTS using the `code-coverage` skill. Run the coverage tool, then focus on gaps in changed/critical code and untested branches, not just the headline percentage. Suggest the highest-value tests to add.

name: generate
description: Generate meaningful tests for a file or function.
body: Generate tests for $ARGUMENTS using the `testing-strategy` and `test-engineer` guidance. Match the project's test framework and style. Cover the happy path, edge cases and failure modes; assert behavior, not implementation. Run the new tests and confirm they pass.

name: e2e
description: Create or run end-to-end tests for a user journey.
body: Work on end-to-end tests for the journey in $ARGUMENTS using the `e2e-testing` skill. Detect the e2e framework (Playwright/Cypress). Use stable role/test-id selectors and explicit waits. Run the tests and report results; quarantine or fix flakiness rather than ignoring it.

name: watch
description: Run tests in watch mode for a fast feedback loop.
body: Start the test runner in watch mode for $ARGUMENTS if the framework supports it. Explain how to interpret the loop and stop it. Use this for TDD-style fast feedback.

name: tdd
description: Drive a feature with red-green-refactor TDD.
body: Implement the feature in $ARGUMENTS using the `tdd-workflow` skill. Write a failing test first (red), the minimal code to pass (green), then refactor with tests green. Work in small steps and show the loop. Do not write the implementation before the test.

name: design
description: Design a clean, consistent, evolvable API for a resource.
body: Design the API for $ARGUMENTS using the `api-design` skill. Define resources, methods, status codes, error shape, pagination and versioning, and note backward-compatibility. Produce a concise spec (and an OpenAPI stub if REST). Keep conventions consistent with any existing API.

name: mock
description: Create a mock server/stubs from an API spec for development.
body: Create mocks for the API in $ARGUMENTS using the `api-openapi` skill. Generate stub responses matching the schema (from an OpenAPI spec if present) so the frontend/clients can develop against them. Keep example data realistic but synthetic.

name: test-endpoint
description: Exercise an API endpoint and validate its response.
body: Test the endpoint described in $ARGUMENTS using the `api-testing-tools` skill. Send the request (curl/httpie), then validate status, headers and body shape. Include a negative/error case. Do not put secrets in the URL; use headers and redact them in output.

name: docs
description: Generate or update API documentation from the spec/code.
body: Produce API docs for $ARGUMENTS using the `api-openapi` and `documentation-writer` skills. Derive them from the real spec/routes (source of truth), include request/response examples and error responses, and keep them in sync with the implementation.

name: contract
description: Set up or check consumer-driven contract tests between services.
body: Work on contract tests for $ARGUMENTS using the `contract-testing` skill. Capture consumer expectations as contracts and verify the provider against them so breaking changes are caught in CI, not production. Keep contracts about behavior, not internals.

name: fix
description: Fix a described bug end-to-end with a regression test.
body: Fix the bug in $ARGUMENTS using the `debugging` and `testing-strategy` skills. First reproduce it (ideally as a failing test), find the root cause, apply the minimal fix, and confirm the test now passes plus the suite is green. Report exactly what you verified.

name: format
description: Format code with the project's configured formatter.
body: Format the code in $ARGUMENTS using the `linting-formatting` skill. Detect and run the project's configured formatter (prettier/black/gofmt/rustfmt/etc.). Do not impose a style the project hasn't chosen; report what ran and what changed.

name: comment
description: Add or improve code comments (explain why, not what).
body: Improve comments/docstrings for $ARGUMENTS using the `code-comments` skill. Explain intent and non-obvious decisions (why), keep them accurate, and remove stale or redundant comments. Do not narrate obvious code line by line.
